title: Phi-Ground-Any: Microsoft GUI Grounding Multimodal Model
summary: A 4B-parameter visual language model specialized in GUI grounding for precise screen element localization. It enables AI agents to interact with complex interfaces across diverse resolutions and aspect ratios.
research_notes: Outperforms OpenAI Operator and Claude Computer Use in GUI click accuracy benchmarks despite its compact size.

evolution.summary: Evolved from the Phi-Ground-4B-7C research model into an official Microsoft project integrated into Windows Copilot's 'Vision Highlighting'. The current 'Any' version features improved robustness for 4K screens and high-resolution UI interaction.
